meta.note: Canonical verified counts for the SZL Holdings platform. Every count below was produced by the exact shell command listed. Run from workspace root to reproduce. Downstream tracks should treat these as the ground-truth baseline and re-run commands to verify before making claims. Database table count (906) uses pnpm metrics:generate and is more reliable than a raw grep — see note.

on_disk_unregistered.command: for d in artifacts/*/; do [ ! -f "${d}.replit-artifact/artifact.toml" ] && echo "${d}"; done | wc -l

domain_packages_dir.note: Filesystem-verified count of all entries under packages/. This supersedes the prior registry-generated count of 77 (generated 2026-04-20). Run 'pnpm metrics:generate' to refresh docs/platform-facts.md.

total_packages.note: packages/ (82) + lib/ (41) = 123. Prior registry count was 118 (77+41).

table_definitions_canonical.note: Canonical count from pnpm metrics:generate (Drizzle-aware schema introspection, last run 2026-04-20). More accurate than raw grep. Re-run pnpm metrics:generate to refresh. Raw grep alternative: grep -rh 'pgTable' lib/db/src/schema/ --include='*.ts' | grep -v '^//' | wc -l (returns ~1078, overcounts due to re-exports).

migration_files.note: Includes files with duplicate sequence numbers (parallel branching). Full list: see audit/database-surface.md.

rbac_roles.note: 11 consistently cited in README.md, docs/security/access-control-matrix.md, and docs/trust/trust-center.md. Confirmed by cross-document consistency.

registered_mobile_artifacts.command: find artifacts -name artifact.toml | xargs grep -l 'expo\|mobile' 2>/dev/null | wc -l
registered_mobile_artifacts.note: cortex-mobile is on disk but unregistered and in concept phase.

domain_packs.note: IMPERIUM and PRISM Counsel (legacy naming) are archived. Sentra and Counsel are the current active domain packs.

live_table_count.note: Schema applied via drizzle push (no __drizzle_migrations table); 730 is the final count after rollback test (dropped 6 tables) and forward-migration restore (+6) plus supplemental migration (+2 indexes, no new tables)

live_db.drizzle_migrations_tracker: ABSENT — schema was applied via drizzle push, not drizzle migrate

indexes.command: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_indexes WHERE schemaname = 'public'

fk_constraints.command: SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.table_constraints WHERE constraint_schema='public' AND constraint_type='FOREIGN KEY'

unique_constraints.command: SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.table_constraints WHERE constraint_schema='public' AND constraint_type='UNIQUE'

check_constraints.command: SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.table_constraints WHERE constraint_schema='public' AND constraint_type='CHECK'
check_constraints.note: Includes NOT NULL and pgEnum constraints generated by Drizzle ORM — not 5707 distinct business-rule validations

pk_constraints.command: SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.table_constraints WHERE constraint_schema='public' AND constraint_type='PRIMARY KEY'

pgTable_call_sites.note: Consistent with Track 1 canonical count of 906 from pnpm metrics:generate (metrics generator de-duplicates re-exports)

drizzle_journal_entries.note: Gaps are non-blocking; journal is self-consistent
